name: artemis-service-table
title: Service table
description: A service ticket table with priority, status, search, selection and row actions.

files.content:
"use client"; // @zeus-internal import type { AnimatedBadgeStatus } from "./badge"; import { AnimatedBadge } from "./badge"; import { TableCheckbox } from "./checkbox"; import { AnimatedMenu } from "./menu"; import records from "./data"; export const MENU_PANEL = "art:artemis-animated-dropdown art:relative art:isolate art:z-[120] art:max-h-[var(--radix-dropdown-menu-content-available-height)] art:min-w-56 art:overflow-y-auto art:rounded-xl art:border art:border-border art:bg-background art:p-1.5 art:text-foreground art:outline-none"; const badgeStatus: Record = { "In review": "info", "In progress": "warning", "Resolved": "success", "Waiting": "neutral" }; const badgeClass: Record = { "In review": "art:border-accent/5 art:bg-accent/15 art:text-foreground", "In progress": "art:border-warning/5 art:bg-warning/15 art:text-foreground", "Resolved": "art:border-success/5 art:bg-success/10 art:text-foreground", "Waiting": "art:border-border/20 art:bg-muted/70 art:text-muted-foreground" }; export function TicketRow({ ticket, index, selected, onToggle }: { ticket: typeof records[number]; index: number; selected: boolean; onToggle: (checked: boolean) => void; }) { return (
{ticket.id}
{ticket.subject}
{ticket.initials} {ticket.account}
{ticket.owner}
{ticket.priority}
{ticket.status}
} panelClassName={MENU_PANEL + " art:w-40"} actions={["Open ticket", "Assign owner", "Change priority", "Mark resolved"].map(label => ({ id: label, label, onSelect: () => { } }))} renderContent={item => <>{item(0)}{item(1)}{item(2)}
